changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE employees ( id UUID NOT NULL, org_id UUID NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, phone VARCHAR(20) NULL, department VARCHAR(100) NULL, designation VARCHAR(100) NULL, metadata JSONB NULL, created_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, updated_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_by UUID NULL, updated_by UUID NULL, CONSTRAINT employees_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_employees_email UNIQUE (email), CONSTRAINT uk_employees_phone UNIQUE (phone) ); CREATE INDEX idx_employees_org_id ON employees (org_id); CREATE INDEX idx_employees_metadata_gin ON employees USING GIN (metadata jsonb_path_ops);
